headline: Frieze London opens with cautious mood among collectors

content.text:
Frieze London and Frieze Masters opened to VIPs in Regent's Park on Wednesday, with dealers describing a measured market in which buyers took longer to commit. Several mid-market galleries reported sales in the 50,000 to 250,000 pound range on the first day.

Luxury brands hosted dinners and private viewings across Mayfair through the week, and New Bond Street boutiques extended opening hours on Thursday evening. The fair runs until Oct 18.
